findings.statement: Every record in this investigation comes from the synthetic demo ledger; no real customer or bank transaction is involved.
ACC-VIC sent ₹2,50,000 to ACC-M1 via IMPS at 2026-02-01T09:00:00.
TXN-T0010 is flagged: ₹2,50,000 is 92.6x the largest of the account's 8 earlier outgoing transfers (₹2,700). Moved 73% of the ₹3,41,200 balance held just before it.
After receiving ₹2,50,000, ACC-M1 sent ₹2,45,000 in 2 transfer(s), the first 0.1 h later. Whether this was the same money is inferred, not proven.
After receiving ₹1,30,000, ACC-M2A sent ₹1,28,000 in 1 transfer(s), the first 0.3 h later. Whether this was the same money is inferred, not proven.
₹1,28,000 left ACC-M2A as an ATM cash-out (TXN-T0013); the ledger cannot follow cash further.
TXN-T0014 moves ₹1,00,000 back to ACC-M1, which is already on the traced path: a cycle.
Model score for ACC-VIC is 25.0%, at or above the review threshold of 17.5%. Largest factor: avg_amount (raises the score).
ACC-VIC: The model suggests review but the fixed rules do not.
Model score for ACC-M1 is 28.3%, at or above the review threshold of 17.5%. Largest factor: avg_amount (raises the score).
ACC-M1: The model suggests review but the fixed rules do not.
Fixed rules score ACC-M2A 65/100 (high): RAPID_PASS_THROUGH; HIGH_FLOW_THROUGH; LIMITED_HISTORY.
ACC-M2A: The fixed rules suggest review but the model scores it below its threshold, which does not clear it.

exposure.method: For each account that received traced funds, its own balance is followed from the first traced receipt to 72 h later. Lower bound (lowest intermediate balance): traced funds are assumed to stay in the account until its balance falls below them. Upper bound: no more than was received, and no more than actually left the account. Ranges are per account and must not be added across hops.
limitations: The observed downstream total counts the same money each time it moves; it is not a loss figure.
Balances combine funds from many sources; no method can prove which rupees were the victim's.
Exposure is computed for up to 60 downstream accounts.
